question: The Desert National Park is renowned for which endangered bird species?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Great Indian Bustard**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Great Indian Bustard is critically endangered and is one of the heaviest flying birds, found mainly in the Indian subcontinent.
 
• The Desert National Park in Rajasthan is one of the primary habitats for the Great Indian Bustard, offering protection to this species.
 
• Its population has drastically declined due to habitat loss, poaching, and human-induced activities, leading to its inclusion in the IUCN Red List under the "Critically Endangered" category.
 
• The Great Indian Bustard is a ground-nesting bird, primarily dependent on grasslands and arid regions for survival.
 
• Conservation programs such as captive breeding and habitat restoration are being actively pursued by the Indian government and wildlife organizations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Desert National Park**

 
 
• Located in Rajasthan, it is one of the largest national parks in India, covering an area of 3162 km².
 
• The park's ecosystem includes sand dunes, rocky terrain, and sparse vegetation, ideal for desert wildlife.
 
• Besides the Great Indian Bustard, the park is home to other species such as Indian fox, desert cat, and sandgrouse.
 
 
 
• **Great Indian Bustard Conservation**
 
 
• The government has launched Project Great Indian Bustard to protect and conserve this critically endangered species.
 
• The Bustard Recovery Program involves captive breeding efforts and habitat management.
 
• Artificial egg incubation and predator control measures are also being implemented to ensure population growth.
 
 
 
• **Critically Endangered Species**
 
 
• Species classified as "Critically Endangered" under the IUCN Red List are at the highest risk of extinction in the wild.
 
• Global efforts such as habitat preservation, anti-poaching laws, and community involvement are vital for their survival.
 
 
 
• **Grassland Ecosystems**
 
 
• Grasslands are crucial for the survival of many species like the Great Indian Bustard, providing food and nesting habitats.
 
• Human activities, including agriculture and urbanization, have severely impacted grassland ecosystems.
 
• Restoring grasslands is essential for maintaining biodiversity and ecological balance.
